newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Polar group unit to place $17 mln paper.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Polar group unit to place $17 mln paper.

text.p: Provencesa, the cereals-producing subsidiary of giant Venezuelan foods and brewing group Polar, is to place eight billion bolivar ($17 million) of commercial notes on Nov. 7, the company said.

The placement -- rated Category A, Sub Category A1 by Venezuelan rating agencies -- is the first of a possible total series of placements that may reach a total of 45 billion bolivars ($95 million), the highest amount ever authorized by Venezuela's National Securities Commission (CNV).
Details of the issue are to be released later this week.
Funds raised will be used to finance purchases of primary supplies of wheat, rice and corn that will later to be used by other Polar units, Provencesa said in a press release.
